dependence_unit.reason: Minutes, contracts, actions, and trades within one session share market state, opportunity state, account state, and serial occupancy and are not independent observations.
forbidden_pseudoreplication: treating five forecast heads as independent samples
treating three model seeds as independent market samples

effective_sample_size.ordered_by: chronological session order within each outer fold
effective_sample_size.raw_n: number of unique sessions with a finite paired statistic
effective_sample_size.autocorrelation_sequence: Compute sample autocorrelation rho_k for k=1..min(5,n-1). Retain the initial strictly positive sequence and stop before the first rho_k <= 0.
effective_sample_size.pooled_rule: Compute fold ESS separately and sum the five fold ESS values. Do not estimate autocorrelation across fold boundaries.
effective_sample_size.inference_note: ESS is a power and sufficiency diagnostic. Confidence intervals and p-values still come from the frozen moving-block bootstrap.

moving_block_bootstrap.per_fold: For a fold with n ordered sessions, sample ceil(n/5) start indices uniformly with replacement from 0..n-1, take five consecutive sessions from each start with circular wraparound, concatenate, and truncate to n.
moving_block_bootstrap.pooled: Resample each outer fold independently with the same replicate number, preserve the original session count in every fold, then concatenate the five resampled folds. Never create a block across a fold boundary.
moving_block_bootstrap.synchronization: Within replicate b, reuse the same fold-specific session index arrays for every candidate lineage, seed, metric, and comparator in the registered family.

seed_derivation.integer: Interpret the first 16 hexadecimal digits as an unsigned integer and reduce modulo 2^32.

moving_block_bootstrap.missing_session_pair: A required paired comparison missing on either side is not silently dropped. It is invalid_evidence unless a preregistered action mask makes the decision absent on both sides, in which case both receive the frozen WAIT utility.

confidence_intervals.per_fold: Report unadjusted two-sided 95% intervals and point estimates. Per-fold statistical significance is not required; fold direction and bounded-fifth rules are hard.
confidence_intervals.pooled: Report unadjusted intervals plus multiplicity-adjusted maxT intervals and p-values. The adjusted pooled lower bounds are the hard improvement gates.
confidence_intervals.strata: Use the identical session-block scheme within the eligible session set. If a stratum has fewer than 20 sessions or ESS below 10, mark it descriptive_only.

studentized_maxT.scope: All active test statistics in the ordered multiplicity ledger for the current gated stage.
studentized_maxT.observed_statistic: t_h = mean_h / cluster_se_h, where cluster_se_h is the standard error of the chronological session-cluster means.
studentized_maxT.centered_null_resample: For each hypothesis h, subtract its observed session mean before applying the synchronized block indices.
studentized_maxT.replicate_maximum: maxT_star_b = max_h(t_h_star_b) for the one-sided improvement family.
studentized_maxT.critical_value: The empirical 0.95 quantile of maxT_star over 20,000 resamples.

nonzero_mean_with_zero_session_variance.reason: A finite market-sampling uncertainty cannot be estimated from a degenerate session series.

independent_reproduction.auditor_input: Hashed decision-level and session-level source ledgers, not producer summaries.
auditor_must_recompute: all bootstrap indices from the frozen seed rule
independent_reproduction.tolerance: Bit-identical categorical results and hashes; floating values must match within max(1e-12, 1e-10 * abs(reference)).
